row.body: A sledge is marked for a station delivery while the fuel can is logged as empty before the driver’s return. The receipt leaves the destination blank.
row.title: The stop at the station

sidecar.gloss: A station delivery and fuel record disagree about the trip’s destination.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency detour could consume fuel and delay a tool delivery; the blank destination does not establish a test route.
